summary_ja: 米国NAIRR、EuroHPC AI Factories、英国AIRRの複線型アクセス比較に、DOE計算施設の過需要指標とNERSC AI for Science公募の資源・支援条件を追加しました。NERSCの申請需要は毎年容量の3～10倍、2025 INCITEは3倍、2024～2025 ALCCは5倍と報告されていますが、要求量をそのまま必要設備容量とは扱いません。AI公募ではGPU、CPU、ストレージ、相談支援、公開データ成果を一体で設計しています。単一モデルによる暫定調査で、Consensusは未完了です。
summary_en: The comparison of multi-route access in the U.S. NAIRR, EuroHPC AI Factories, and UK AIRR is extended with demand-pressure indicators at DOE computing facilities and resource and support conditions in the NERSC AI for Science call. NERSC requests are reported at three to ten times annual capacity, 2025 INCITE at three times, and 2024-2025 ALCC at five times, but requested amounts are not treated directly as required installed capacity. The AI call combines GPU, CPU, storage, consulting, and public-data deliverables. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

items.name_ja: DOE計算施設の配分需要超過
items.name_en: Allocation demand pressure at DOE computing facilities
items.timing_ja: DOE FY2026予算要求に記載された近年の配分需要
items.timing_en: Recent allocation demand reported in the DOE FY2026 budget request
items.statement_ja: DOEはNERSCの利用申請が毎年容量の3～10倍、2025年INCITEが利用可能資源の3倍、2024～2025年ALCCが5倍と報告します。申請には過大見積り、同一課題の複数経路申請、配分後の未消費があり得るため、この倍率は需要圧力の指標であり、同倍率の設備増強を直接意味しません。
items.statement_en: DOE reports annual NERSC requests at three to ten times capacity, 2025 INCITE demand at three times available resources, and 2024-2025 ALCC demand at five times resources. Requests may include overestimation, applications through multiple routes, and later under-consumption, so these ratios indicate allocation pressure rather than a direct requirement for equal capacity growth.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIも申請量だけでなく採択量、実消費、待ち時間、未達理由、分野・規模別需要を記録すれば、設備不足、配分制度、利用支援のどこが律速かを分けられます。
items.hpci_relevance_en: By recording awards, consumption, queues, reasons for under-use, and demand by domain and scale in addition to requests, HPCI can separate capacity shortage from allocation-policy and user-support bottlenecks.
adoption_conditions_ja: 申請、査定、配分、消費、未消費、待ち時間を課題と資源種別ごとに追跡する。
同一課題の重複申請、将来予約、過大見積りを補正した潜在需要を推定する。
需要超過を設備増強だけで解消せず、支援、ソフトウェア、データ、予約制度の改善効果を測る。
adoption_conditions_en: Track requests, review adjustments, awards, consumption, under-use, and queue delay by project and resource type.
Estimate latent demand after correcting duplicate requests, advance reservations, and overestimation.
Measure effects of support, software, data, and reservation changes rather than treating hardware expansion as the only response.

items.name_ja: NERSC AI for Science公募の資源・支援・成果の組合せ
items.name_en: Combined resources, support, and deliverables in the NERSC AI for Science call
items.statement_ja: NERSCの2026 AI for Science公募は、採択課題へ当初最大1万Perlmutter GPUノード時間（1ノード4 A100）とストレージを配分し、公開AI-readyデータセット生成には最大2万CPUノード時間を提示します。NERSC職員は効率的実行の相談を行いますが、原則としてモデル開発は対象外です。申請は資源が尽きるまでローリング審査され、GPU時間だけでなく成果物、実行計画、チーム能力を評価します。
items.statement_en: The 2026 NERSC AI for Science call initially offers accepted projects up to 10,000 Perlmutter GPU node-hours, with four A100 GPUs per node, plus storage, and up to 20,000 CPU node-hours for producing public AI-ready datasets. NERSC staff consult on effective execution but generally not model development. Proposals are reviewed on a rolling basis until resources are awarded and are evaluated on deliverables, utilization plans, and team readiness as well as resource quantities.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIのAI枠もGPUだけを配るのではなく、CPU前処理、保存、公開可能データ、実行支援、成果報告を一つの配分契約として設計できます。支援範囲を明記しないと職員工数が隠れたボトルネックになります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: HPCI AI allocations can bundle CPU preprocessing, storage, publishable data, execution support, and outcome reporting rather than distribute GPU time alone. Unspecified support scope creates a hidden staff bottleneck.
adoption_conditions_ja: GPU、CPU、ストレージ、ネットワーク、支援工数の申請・配分・実消費を一つの課題単位で測る。
実行支援、モデル開発、科学評価、データ整備の責任境界と窓口を明示する。
公開データ要件が機密・知財・共同研究契約と両立しない課題には別経路を用意する。
adoption_conditions_en: Measure requested, awarded, and consumed GPU, CPU, storage, network, and support labor per project.
State responsibility and contact boundaries for execution support, model development, science review, and data preparation.
Provide a separate route when public-data requirements conflict with confidentiality, intellectual property, or collaboration agreements.

remaining_work_en: GAP-TDS-088 remains open; HPCI needs publishable statistics connecting requests, review adjustments, awards, consumption, queues, and support labor by resource type.
Published demand ratios at NERSC and peers still require evidence on duplicate requests, overestimation, under-consumption, and project-level queue delay.
Independent-model primary-source review and Consensus remain incomplete.
